user.title: Chinese Calendar
user.description: Set up the Chinese Calendar integration.

data_description.holiday_extra: Optional. Built-in statutory holiday data covers up to 2026. Paste incremental/fix data (lunar-python HolidayUtil.fix format, 18 chars per day) if the library is not up to date. Leave empty to use built-in data.

data_description.anniversaries_text: Separate entries with ';'. Entry format: name|type|date. type = solar (Gregorian) or lunar (Chinese lunar); date = MMDD (recur yearly) or YYYYMMDD (with year, shows age/anniversary). Example: Mom|lunar|0321; Wedding|solar|20101010
data_description.custom_holidays_text: Separate entries with ';'. Entry format: name|date. date = MMDD (recur yearly) or YYYYMMDD (once). Shown in the calendar like statutory holidays. Example: Christmas|1225; Company Day|20261001
